CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE R. NATARAJ  ORAL ORDER

The petitioners have challenged the prosecution launched against them in C.C No.354/2020 pending trial before the Civil Judge (Jr.Dn) and JMFC, Ponnampet for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961.

3. sentences.text: In this regard, the learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo along with the related documents The memo and the documents are taken on record.

5. A perusal of the above documents would indicate that the respondent No.2 has specifically agreed in O.S No.15/2023 that she would withdraw C.C No.354/2020 and Cr.M.C No.136/2022, registered by the respondent No.1.
6. In that view of the matter, the petition is allowed.

The prosecution launched against the petitioners in C.C No.354/2020 pending trial before the Civil Judge (Jr.Dn) and JMFC, Ponnampet registered for offences punishable under NC: 2026:KHC:16679 HC-KAR Sections 498A, 506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 is quashed.
